summary.text: Cliff Hayes is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 91, representing parts of Chesapeake and Portsmouth, serving since November 22, 2016. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Communications, Technology and Innovation (chair), Appropriations, Health and Human Services, and Rules.

paragraphs.text: C. E. "Cliff" Hayes Jr. was born in Chesapeake, Virginia, according to the House's member profile.

The profile says he earned a B.S. in computer information systems from Norfolk State University in 1991 and an MMGT in business administration from Cambridge College in 2010, and lists his occupation as CIO and director of technology.
The profile lists his memberships as including Chesapeake Men for Progress, Omega Psi Phi Fraternity and the Urban League of Hampton Roads.
It shows him chairing the Communications, Technology and Innovation Committee and the General Government and Capital Outlay Subcommittee of Appropriations.
